title: PR #74: docs: separate master architecture from canonical specification
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Separation

- Adds top-level `SPECIFICATION.md` as the system-level normative contract surface.
- Moves the clearly normative Quest data contract, deterministic AI boundary, Dialogue Runtime API contract, and AURORA-001 evidence-state contract out of `ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Keeps architecture responsible for system topology, boundaries, ownership and placement.
- Keeps implementation/evidence semantics explicit: specification does not imply implementation.

## Constraint

No component implementation is moved into the ecosystem repository. Component source remains owned by its canonical repository.

This PR is documentation/specification separation only; implementation status must continue to be established from source, tests, exact-SHA CI and E2E evidence.
